scenario_description:
Objective: Gain a small printed recognition tag for a recent indoor boulder send during an already planned community night.
Emerging Need: The board is only a possibility until staff confirms the eligible climbs, submission contact, required fields, and print cutoff.
Decision Context: Julian's route journal is needed to know whether one listed climb matches his actual send and to supply the date and attempt count accurately.
Consequence: Timely use of the entry window could add a harmless keepsake; ignoring it leaves the climbing night unchanged after the print batch closes.

parameter.title: Riverside Friday community boulder night
parameter.description: Casual Friday climbing night with the reset wall open and a community board near the front desk.
parameter.location: High Point Climbing Riverside, Chattanooga, TN

parameter.subject: Friday community night: Flashback Sends board being tested
parameter.body: For Friday's community night, staff may print a small Flashback Sends board using a few climbs from this week's reset. The eligible climb list and entry method are not final yet, so please do not send entries until the final list posts.

parameter.content: I saw the test board at Riverside tonight. The orange arete was penciled in as a candidate, but the desk said they are still matching route names and grades and are not taking member entries yet.

parameter.name: Riverside Community Board
parameter.notes: QR card contact for member community-night board submissions only.

parameter.subject: Flashback Sends final list and 2 p.m. print window
parameter.body: The final Flashback Sends list for Friday is Orange Arete V3, Blue Corner V4, and Yellow Pinch V2. Members may email the Riverside Community Board contact by 2:00 p.m. today with name, selected climb, send date, and attempt count for an optional free printed tape tag. There is no ranking or cash prize; late sends can still be handwritten at the event.

parameter.subject: Flashback Sends print batch is closed
parameter.body: The 2:00 p.m. export for printed Flashback Sends tape tags is complete, and no additional printed tags can be added for Friday. Members can still climb as usual and write new sends on the board during community night.
